confidence.caveat: The account mix did not resolve to a structural profile, so this threshold is the cross-profile default rather than a tuned one. Cash-flow lines are indirect-method approximations because no prior period was supplied; working-capital movements carry a wide band.

comparison_basis.description: statutory EBITDA is expressed as a share of the company's own asset base — the base an asset method would value it on — so the zero floor prints in the same units on both sides

why_here.rationale: Earnings multiples are undefined for a micro-cap operator (structure not inferable) at non-positive EBITDA; asset and revenue methods carry the valuation instead, and saying so is more useful to the shareholder than a multiple computed on a negative denominator.

needs_history.statement: This upload carries 1 period (FY2025) across 1 calendar year. 8 of 8 multi-period analyses cannot run yet: Decoupling from its driver (needs 2 comparable periods); Same period last year (needs 2 comparable periods, 2 calendar years); Period-end entry reversed after the date (needs 3 comparable periods); Working-capital cycle break (needs 3 comparable periods); Dormant balance (needs 4 comparable periods); Multi-period deterioration (needs 4 comparable periods); Sustained direction (needs 4 comparable periods); Outlier movement (needs 5 comparable periods). No trend, no median and no year-over-year figure was computed from this period.

provenance.rule: every money figure a single-period row cites is checked against the FactsGateway accessor that serves it; Radar cites the verified ones, withholds the ones no accessor resolves (the reason is on the row), and refuses a row whose figure contradicts the gateway
